campaign: Static imports and session rule robustness
interpretation: 50 distinct focused source and boundary reviews. Test matrix variants, rechecks and benchmark repetitions are not additional passes. This is not 50 complete repository audits or a fleet adoption claim.

passes.topic: Import replacement preserves the actual binding
passes.result: Recommend the real assignment name, omit a redundant alias, and keep complex targets advisory.

passes.topic: Qualified and direct loader provenance
passes.result: Resolve stdlib provenance through qualified, direct and aliased imports.

passes.topic: Representable module names and Unicode normalization
passes.result: Reject nonrepresentable or normalization-changing import spellings.

passes.topic: Lazy, optional and guarded import timing
passes.result: Keep function, class, guarded and configured loads outside eager-import advice.

passes.topic: Namespace mutation and escaped import providers
passes.result: Abstain when mutation or dynamic namespace access invalidates loader provenance.

passes.topic: Literal calls and assignment shapes
passes.result: Do not invent a variable binding for an expression or complex assignment target.

passes.topic: Constructor argument expansion and duplicate binding
passes.result: Share conservative positional and keyword binding; reject unpacking and duplicate bindings.

passes.topic: Dependency aliases and module-level singleton ownership
passes.result: Keep fixture parameters valid; source-visible module-level store instances must also enter tests through fixtures.

passes.topic: Source-proven collaborator protocols
passes.result: Require a declared port stored and invoked by the receiving service.

passes.topic: Exception and resource lifecycle ownership
passes.result: Keep constructions inside raises contexts and preserve fixture lifecycle guidance.

passes.topic: Factories and construction under test
passes.result: Keep factory fixtures, settings validation and the object under test meaningful.

passes.topic: Collected pytest scopes and fixture decorators
passes.result: Exclude fixture functions, inherited test contracts and support modules.

passes.topic: Contiguous Pydantic assertion runs
passes.result: Group distinct declared fields of one proven receiver without deleting None guards.

passes.topic: Inherited Pydantic data fields
passes.result: Include single-base source-visible inheritance and remove subclass ClassVar overrides.

passes.topic: Annotated type versus annotation metadata
passes.result: Inspect the type argument; ClassVar appearing only as metadata does not erase a field.

passes.topic: Identity, custom comparisons and effectful expected values
passes.result: Retain comparison semantics, repeated fields, messages and calls rather than rewriting them.

passes.topic: Mutation and control-flow grouping
passes.result: Share statement-block traversal and report each nested assertion run once.

passes.topic: Async, method and return annotation provenance
passes.result: Resolve annotated inputs and source-visible construction or validation results.

passes.topic: Object in parameters, returns and class fields
passes.result: Use lexical provenance rather than suppressing an entire module for an unrelated local object name.

passes.topic: Literal and Annotated metadata boundaries
passes.result: Resolve wrapper imports in the annotation scope; skip metadata values.

passes.topic: Acyclic and cyclic object alias traversal
passes.result: Reuse alias visits at each minimum depth instead of expanding a shared graph exponentially.

passes.topic: Generic parameters shadowing type aliases
passes.result: Resolve aliases to their actual declaration and evaluate their bodies in definition scope; preserve local class shadows and generic parameter boundaries.

passes.topic: Raw validation inputs versus JSON text
passes.result: Preserve model_validate(obj=raw); model_validate_json requires a text or byte contract.

passes.topic: Framework methods and module-level decorator decoys
passes.result: Framework exclusions require a class method; override exclusions require inheritance.

passes.topic: Enum and nominal settings defaults
passes.result: Derive domain advice from actual defaults, never from a field name.

passes.topic: Settings primitive and Field provider scope
passes.result: Ignore unrelated local shadows while preserving class and generic type shadows.

passes.topic: Settings URL schemes and malformed defaults
passes.result: Limit URL guidance to demonstrated supported absolute schemes and preserve input parsing.

passes.topic: Settings numeric bounds and optionality
passes.result: Advise standard positive types only for exact zero bounds, without rewriting other constraints.

passes.topic: Settings data fields versus class metadata
passes.result: Reuse the corrected ClassVar and Annotated type boundary.

passes.topic: Stable NewType declarations and default behavior
passes.result: Reuse module rebinding analysis to reject reassigned nominal factories.

passes.topic: Opaque mapping types and builtin shadowing
passes.result: Preserve lexical runtime and annotation provenance, including generic parameters.

passes.topic: Fixed mapping keys versus forwarding
passes.result: Keep dynamic keys, forwarding, homogeneous maps and ambiguous aliases outside the rule.

passes.topic: Mapping discriminator and truth probes
passes.result: Keep source-proven fixed-key parsing checks under the existing Pydantic owner.

passes.topic: Registered raw callback ownership
passes.result: Require registration and stable callback provenance; names and lexical nesting are insufficient.

passes.topic: Shared mapping alias graph complexity
passes.result: Cache annotation facts with scope, mapping role and depth in the key.

passes.topic: Mapping suppressions, generated sources and test oracles
passes.result: Keep exact-code suppressions and asserted test-oracle boundaries.

passes.topic: Implementation commentary across application and test scopes
passes.result: Keep warning-level review of long prose before executable code in every supported scope.

passes.topic: Comment rationale and external citations
passes.result: Review long rationale while preserving protection against accumulator errors.

passes.topic: Comment directives, structured lists and generated source
passes.result: Preserve owned exclusions and concise constraints.

passes.topic: Comment grouping and source coordinates
passes.result: Check adjacency, indentation and codepoint coordinates with a Unicode control.

passes.topic: Accumulator collection provenance
passes.result: A shadowed collection constructor keeps the general warning instead of an unjustified error.

passes.topic: Shared statement blocks without nested-scope duplication
passes.result: Reuse one iterative block traversal for model assertions and commentary.

passes.topic: Quoted tuple records and unit-test helpers
passes.result: Keep fixed positional record checks in tests, fixtures, helpers and methods.

passes.topic: Tuple provider provenance
passes.result: Resolve typing_extensions Tuple and Annotated providers without escalating newly detected records to errors.

passes.topic: Variadic tuple Unpack provenance
passes.result: Recognize real typing Unpack aliases; a same-named application type no longer hides a fixed record.

passes.topic: Tuple aliases, unions and Annotated types
passes.result: Preserve warning staging for expanded annotations and existing direct-tuple severity.

passes.topic: Inherited tuple protocol compatibility
passes.result: Preserve framework and inherited tuple protocols.

passes.topic: Malformed tuple annotations and legacy severity
passes.result: Retain malformed-input tolerance and start newly detected application Unpack cases as warnings.

passes.topic: Shared declaration, annotation and argument facts
passes.result: Reuse DeclaredClass, lexical annotation origins, module rebinding and call binding across owners.

passes.topic: Integration, suppression, formatter and immutable performance calibration
passes.result: Check paired corpus replay, exact suppressions, rule-order and parallel parity, all native gates and versioned publication.

verification.integration_note: Python engine source is unchanged between bases. Refresh generated artifacts and external diagnostic integration tests; exact-head CI qualifies the combined candidate.

immutable_corpus_replay.method: run_isolated_corpora with unchanged verified source pins and all eight affected rules

inspected_delta.classification: Upstream framework reflection APIs legitimately accept opaque Python values. Keep warning-stage review and explained exact-code exceptions; do not promote to errors.

immutable_corpus_replay.limits: Selected frozen snapshots, not an unbiased production sample. Previously existing findings were not all relabeled. The clean public fixture matrix does not establish universal precision.

performance.method: Three paired fresh processes; each scans the same 50 files with all 182 rules twice. Cold and warm medians and maximum available process RSS are reported.
performance.limits: Process RSS includes the interpreter and allocator. These small selected corpora do not establish a fleet-wide speed or memory budget.

limitations: Static imports are advised only for direct eager module-level loads with a representable literal absolute module name. Import timing and complex target changes require review; no automatic rewrite.
Model fields require source-visible declarations. Inheritance expansion is bounded to supported single-base chains; ambiguous multiple inheritance and unknown models remain outside the proof.
Fixture advice requires demonstrated collaborator or settings provenance. Dynamic argument unpacking and ambiguous ownership abstain; construction under test and lifecycle contracts remain valid.
Genuinely opaque Python contracts and framework reflection APIs can require explained exact-code exceptions. JSON text validation requires a text or byte contract.
Settings advice derives from defaults and metadata. Preserve aliases, optionality, environment parsing, accepted schemes, coercion and constraints; do not turn on blanket strict mode.

Long implementation prose remains a review warning; concise constraints, directives, licenses, structured lists, generated files and docstrings remain excluded. Existing proven accumulator errors are preserved.
Freshly detected application types named Unpack begin as warnings; real typing and typing_extensions variadic tuples remain valid.
